description: Issue #862 root cause: EtlJobDefinition has implemented ITenant since ETL-006, but ApplyEtlModels() registers ETL entity types into the EF model AFTER FrameworkContext.OnModelCreating's Pass 2 loop (DataContext.cs) has already finished applying the ITenant query filter -- so the filter was never actually enforced. This mutant deletes the ApplyEtlTenantFilter<EtlJobDefinition>(builder, context) call added to ApplyEtlModels(ModelBuilder, EmptyContext) to fix that, reproducing the exact pre-fix behaviour: a context scoped to tenant A can read tenant B's EtlJobDefinition row by id, with the generated SQL carrying no TenantCode predicate at all. Checked against EtlTenantIsolationTests.EtlJobDefinition_TenantA_CannotReadTenantB_Job, which seeds two EtlJobDefinition rows under two different tenants and asserts a context scoped to tenant A cannot resolve tenant B's row -- with the mutant applied, that read succeeds and the assertion fails. The green control, EtlJobDefinition_TenantA_CanReadOwnJob, seeds the same tenant pair and asserts tenant A can still read its OWN EtlJobDefinition row -- proving the mutation does not have broader collateral effects (e.g. breaking the EtlJobDefinitions table registration itself).

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Api.Test.EtlTenantIsolat: #862: a context scoped to tenant A must NOT resolve tenant B's EtlJobDefinition by GUID

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed: Captured verbatim against the committed baseline (stale demo.db under bin/ removed first; mutant patch applied via git apply, test run, then reverted via git apply -R): 'Assert.IsNull failed. #862: a context scoped to tenant A must NOT resolve tenant B's EtlJobDefinition by GUID. If this fails, ApplyEtlModels(ModelBuilder, EmptyContext) is no longer applying the ITenant query filter for EtlJobDefinition.' Confirmed via python3 test/mutants/run_mutant.py --mutant etl862-applyetlmodels-tenantfilter-neutralize: 'VERDICT: KILLED' / 'GATE: PASS'.
